title: Herbed Spanish Potato Tortilla Espanola
description: A silky, crowd-pleaser Spanish tortilla featuring a sweet glace cherry glaze and a spicy fermented kimchi topping.
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes; dice onion finely; mince garlic.
In a bowl, toss potatoes, onion, garlic with smoked paprika, oregano, sea salt, pepper, and chopped parsley.
Heat olive oil in a 10-inch cast iron skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add potato mixture to skillet, spread evenly, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are golden and tender.
Whisk oat milk in a small bowl; pour over the potato mixture; stir gently to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover skillet, and cook for 15 minutes, letting the mixture set into a silky tortilla.
While the tortilla sets, simmer cherries, sugar, water, and lemon zest until thickened, then strain to obtain a glossy glaze.
Remove tortilla from skillet, slide onto a cutting board, slice into wedges, drizzle each wedge with glace cherry, and sprinkle sliced fermented kimchi on top; serve warm.
